descFull: Free ADB GUI and Android Emulator control panel for macOS. One click for dark mode, font scale, RTL and pseudo-locales, TalkBack, layout bounds, network speed and GPS: no adb commands. Layout Inspector in dp for any app (Compose and Views) with Figma overlay and TalkBack-order audit. Plus an MCP server for AI agents.
